statement: One 128-bit digest per published record over every database row its dossier was built from, plus the release-wide context digest. A later release reuses a record's dossier bytes only while both are unchanged and its clock-dependent score terms cannot have moved; a sample of reused records is rebuilt and compared every cycle.
